tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap scaffolded the WinUI 3 shell and mapping; build finished with 0 errors (migration-score.json notes.winui_build).

tools_problematic.problem: Scaffold injects <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/></Window.SystemBackdrop>; the agent kept it. A windowed SystemBackdrop composites XAML through DWM so screen-capture/PrintWindow of the HWND returns a blank/solid frame.
tools_problematic.evidence: MainWindow.xaml lines 11-13; discrepancies.json 'blank-render' critical; winui screenshot 11KB solid vs UWP 145KB.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only checks process-alive, not whether the window paints content; a blank-but-alive window passes.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static guard that flags a leftover scaffold SystemBackdrop when the UWP source never used acrylic/mica.

special_apis.special_handling: Translucent backdrops make the window content non-capturable by PrintWindow/BitBlt and diverge from the UWP's opaque background; should be removed unless the UWP explicitly used AcrylicBrush.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated window renders visually blank (only caption buttons paint) while UIA tree is fully populated (53 elements, non-zero bounds).
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold's <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/> composites content through DWM; screenshot tooling captures only the transparent backdrop layer as a solid/blank frame. The UWP original used an opaque background and no backdrop.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the scaffold <Window.SystemBackdrop> element and give the root content an explicit opaque Background so the app paints solid, capturable content matching the UWP.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App builds, launches, full UIA tree, but client area paints solid white in every capture method.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Not detected by the agent at all — it declared done; the blank render only surfaced in the scoring/parity capture.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Kept the scaffold MicaBackdrop the UWP never had; backdrop-composited content is not captured by PrintWindow/BitBlt.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A migration-skill rule + validator WARN to remove the scaffold SystemBackdrop and set an opaque background unless the UWP used acrylic/mica.

missing_tooling.need: A static signal that catches blank-render-prone scaffold defaults (SystemBackdrop) before scoring.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire 0-score visual-parity failure on an otherwise correct migration.
